EB01-074:Q330: Multiplayer-only: orders the choices of several enemy players (starting from the active player, in the direction of play). A 1v1 game has exactly one enemy player, so there is no order to observe; the single enemy player's choice is covered by the EB01-074:Q329 test (docs/CONFLICTS.md ambiguous:multiplayer-vocabulary, rules section 12 out of scope).
